title: Towards trustworthy multi-modal motion prediction: Holistic evaluation and interpretability of outputs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze religion or faith. The benchmarks measure the accuracy, diversity, admissibility, and robustness of motion prediction models for autonomous vehicles.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith as it focuses on technical aspects of motion prediction for autonomous vehicles.
